Our Story

One Place for Considered Aesthetic Care

NeoSculpt6 was founded by Dr Sandeep Mahapatra after more than two decades of treating hair, skin and ageing concerns. The idea was simple: one clinic in Whitefield where every concern is diagnosed by a senior doctor before any treatment is offered. Today it brings dermatology and plastic surgery under one roof.

  • Our Mission

    To diagnose before we treat, and to recommend only what each patient needs — even when that means no procedure.

  • Our Vision

    A clinic where every aesthetic decision starts with an honest medical opinion and ends with a natural result.

Care That Values Clarity, Privacy and Time

  • Clear Conversations

    Unhurried consultations that cover options, limitations, recovery and cost before anything is planned.

  • Respectful Privacy

    Sensitive concerns are discussed one-to-one; your photographs are never shared without written consent.

  • Coordinated Care

    Dermatology and plastic surgery work together, so your plan is never limited to one specialist's offer.

A Clear Process Before Any Treatment Decision

  1. 01

    Step 1: Begin With Your Concern

    Call, WhatsApp or book online and describe what you'd like to change.

  2. 02

    Step 2: Assess Suitability

    Your doctor examines you and, where relevant, uses AI hair or donor analysis, skin or body-composition assessment.

  3. 03

    Step 3: Discuss the Right Options

    The recommended option, alternatives, sessions or grafts, recovery time and full cost, in a written plan.

  4. 04

    Step 4: Move Forward With Clarity

    Decide in your own time; if you go ahead, the same doctor leads your treatment and follow-up.

Founder & Lead Doctor

Dr Sandeep Mahapatra

Founder · Senior Consultant Dermatologist · Cosmetic Expert · Hair Transplant Surgeon

For more than two decades Dr Sandeep has treated hair loss, skin and ageing concerns as medical problems first and cosmetic ones second. He developed the Neo Follicle Transplant (NFT) approach to graft handling and implantation, has performed 10,000+ hair transplants, and has trained 18+ surgeons — with 55+ specialists formed under his guidance.

  • MD Dermatology, Venereology & Leprosy (Gold Medalist)RIMS, Ranchi
